ID: `fixing-accessibility`.

## What it does

Applies checks for accessible names, keyboard interaction, focus, dialogs, semantics, forms and dynamic messages. Identifies the line or fragment causing the problem and proposes a small correction, preferring native HTML and existing accessible primitives. Does not restructure unrelated areas or migrate the UI library to apply a single check.

## When to use it

Use it when adding a control or when a defect is reproducible: an unnamed button, lost focus after closing a dialog, or an error not associated with its field. For an extensive flow review, use better-accessibility.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/fixing-accessibility` in Claude Code or `$fixing-accessibility` in Codex. Specify the file, component and failing behavior. Ask for the precise problem, reason and a minimal correction. After a change, test the keyboard path and announced name or state when these are the intervention criteria.

## What it delivers

- Responsible fragment and consequence
- Targeted correction
- Outcome of the relevant check

## Example

The icon-only button for removing a filter has no accessible name. Fix it and verify that it is reachable by keyboard.
